title: Block captain is needed
summary: A Block Captain is needed to deliver Link booklets door to door on Thatch Way (84-96 & 112-122) by the end of each month, starting August.
_summary_source_original: A Block Captain is needed to deliver the Link booklets door to door to Thatch Way numbers 84-96 & 112-122 year round. The next delivery will be the end of August. The books will be delivered to your home the last week of each month for you to deliver door to door on Thatch Way before the end of each month.
